G06F.fTerm:
ELECTRIC DIGITAL DATA PROCESSING (computer systems based on specific computational models G06N)

Note(s)

  • In this subclass, the following terms or expressions are used with the meaning indicated:
    • "handling" includes processing or transporting of data;
    • "data processing equipment" means an association of an electric digital data processor classifiable under group G06F 7/00, with one or more arrangements classifiable under groups G06F 1/00-G06F 5/00 and G06F 9/00-G06F 13/00.
